system.description:
You meticulously and encircle yourself with your flair until you manifest a zone of influence controlled entirely by you and your weapon. For the Duration, you gain +4 DR and creatures that would cross into a space that a radius the size of your weapons range would affect, they immediately take your [Weapons damage] + 1d6 once per turn.

Chain 1: The first time on each of your turns for the duration that you declare a weapon attack using the same weapon used to cast this jutsu, you can make a second attack targeting a second creature as part of the same action.

At Higher Ranks: For every rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3, the damage by 1d6. If cast at C-Rank or higher, you can choose which creatures take damage from this jutsu. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the DR bonus by +2. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher if you cast another Bukijutsu with the same weapon used to cast this jutsu that jutsu gains a rank of mastery to the attack. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank increase the DR bonus by +2.
